paraphrase: Bankei tells his audience there is no need to raise a great doubt or to work on old cases; turning the buddha-mind into a 'doubt-mass' substitutes a doubt for the buddha-mind; simply abide in the Unborn.
speaker: Bankei Yōtaku

paraphrase: What everyone has from their parents is only the unborn buddha-mind; the unborn buddha-mind illuminates everything — while listening to me, if a crow caws or a sparrow chirps you know it without intending to; that is hearing with the Unborn. Do not trade the buddha-mind for anger, desire or self-concern.
speaker: Bankei Yōtaku
